evals.name: check-is-read-only-and-reports-scan-candidate
evals.prompt: /gaming:setup check (runtime_dll and runtime_source are unset, <data-dir>\runtime\nvngx_dlssnr.dll does not exist, and an installed Steam title holds data\streamline\nvngx_dlssnr.dll with the known-good hash)
evals.expected_output: Resolves data_dir model-side to a literal path, runs the read-only probes including -Verb discover (which names each game's launcher), and reports a PASS/FAIL/INFO table. The runtime row is FAIL because the DLL is missing, and its remediation names the Steam candidate by path with its gate result (known-good hash, passes) and says apply would copy it. It does not call provision in any form, and nothing is copied into <data-dir>\runtime or anywhere else.
expectations: Reports the missing runtime DLL as FAIL
Names the scan candidate's path and its gate result
Does not run provision -Runtime or provision, and copies or writes no file
Composes no command line carrying a ${user_config.*} token

evals.name: missing-dll-no-candidate-no-source-is-fail
evals.prompt: /gaming:setup check (runtime_dll and runtime_source are unset, <data-dir>\runtime\nvngx_dlssnr.dll does not exist, and no discovered game folder, from any launcher, holds any nvngx_dlssnr.dll)
evals.expected_output: The runtime row is FAIL. The remediation states the scan found no candidate and runtime_source is unset, then names the three remedies in provision -Runtime's order: set runtime_dll to a copy the user already has, install a DLSS 5 title on this machine, set runtime_source to a copy the user controls. It states the plugin names no source of its own and does not suggest any download site for the DLL.
expectations: Reports the runtime DLL as FAIL, not INFO
Lists the three remedies in the order runtime_dll, installed DLSS 5 title, runtime_source
States the plugin names no source for the runtime DLL and names none

evals.name: apply-is-idempotent
evals.prompt: /gaming:setup apply (a previous apply already created the data directory, seeded LEDGER.md with the user's own rows, placed a known-good runtime DLL, and provisioned both fork builds)
evals.expected_output: Runs check, then the apply steps through the script's verbs. The directory creation is a no-op, LEDGER.md is left untouched because it exists, provision -Runtime prints runtime ok and copies nothing, and provision prints already provisioned for dagherbou and wilsjo2. It passes -RuntimeDll and -RuntimeSource only when those options are set, never runs setup_windows.bat, then re-runs check and reports its actual table.
expectations: Calls the script's provision verbs rather than downloading or extracting by hand
Reports runtime ok and already provisioned, with no new download or copy
Never runs setup_windows.bat and re-runs check at the end
